description: Connect a project subdomain to Maker’s HQ
variableDescription: cname: exact CNAME target returned by Vercel for the registered project hostname; proof: complete server-generated makershq-domain= ownership TXT value; verificationHost: optional Vercel-issued verification TXT name; relative to the request host/domain for Cloudflare, or fully-qualified with a trailing dot for Vercel DNS; verification: complete vc-domain-verify= value returned by Vercel.
